# ThunderStudy AI

ThunderStudy AI is a free browser-based flashcard maker for students. Wondermayank builds and maintains it so students can turn topics, notes, PDFs, images and YouTube transcripts into revision decks.

## Main pages

- [Flashcard maker](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/) — Create AI flashcards from topics, questions, notes and source files.
- [Text flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/home.html) — Start a deck from a topic, question or pasted study text.
- [Preset decks](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/dack.html) — Browse and generate focused study decks.
- [Image to flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/img.html) — Extract text from images and scans with browser OCR.
- [PDF to flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/pdf.html) — Turn PDF notes and textbook material into cards.
- [YouTube to flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/youtube.html) — Create cards from supported video transcripts.
- [Webpage to flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/url.html) — Fetch readable text from a webpage URL and turn it into cards.
- [CUET Commerce deck](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/decks/cuet-bs-ch1.html) — Review a Commerce management deck.
- [CBSE Business Studies deck](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/decks/cuet-bs-ch2.html) — Review Class 12 Business Studies cards.
- [About ThunderStudy AI](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about.html) — Learn about Wondermayank and the project mission.
- [FAQ](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq.html) — Find answers about creating, importing, exporting and saving decks.
- [Changelog](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new.html) — Read the latest product and publishing updates.

Contact: contact@wondermayank.indevs.in
